title: Short Chains, Deep Thoughts: Balancing Reasoning Efficiency and Intra-Segment Capability via Split-Merge Optimization
reasoning: The paper focuses on optimizing the reasoning efficiency and logical consistency of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs). It uses the term 'faithfulness' in a technical sense to describe the logical accuracy of reasoning steps, not in a religious or spiritual context. There is no evaluation of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
